name: Splash Protocol
description: Cardano DEX combining AMM pools with a virtual limit order book, so a single order can draw on both liquidity sources. SPLASH locks to veSPLASH for a share of protocol fees.
notes: Splash is the Cardano side of the former Spectrum Finance, which split into Splash (Cardano) and ErgoDEX (Ergo); Cardano-side Spectrum pools migrated here. Asset list is restricted to what could be confirmed from official sources (ADA and the SPLASH token) — no authoritative top-pools listing was obtained, so it is incomplete rather than exhaustive.
